soldier: Head brown, the base of the nasus darker, nasus reddish brown, anterior lobe of the pronotum paler than the nasus, posterior lobe concolorous with the head, legs yellow; the head with several sparse long hairs, the tip of the nasus with several as well. Large form: head transversely broadly rounded, widest about the middle, the posterior margin slightly concave; in lateral view the vertex slightly raised and the base of the nasus slightly raised; antennae with 13 to 14 segments, mostly 13, segment 3 longest, the apical teeth of the mandibles rather distinct; pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior lobe shorter than the posterior lobe, the incisions in the middle of the anterior and posterior margins distinct. Medium form: colour slightly paler in all parts, chaetotaxy as in the large form; head broadly pear-shaped, widest slightly behind the middle, the posterior margin flat and slightly concave in the middle, the nasus in lateral view slightly turned up with the base slightly raised and the apex bulging slightly outwards, nasus conical, the apical teeth of the mandibles mostly indistinct; antennae with 13 segments, segment 3 longest. Small form: paler still, chaetotaxy as in the two preceding forms; head nearly circular, widest slightly behind the middle, the nasus in lateral view turned up with the apex rather flat; antennae with 12 to 13 segments, the apical teeth of the mandibles indistinct.
taxonomy_note: The original work placed it in the genus Mironasutitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Nasutitermes.
